changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS SELECT t.trade_date, c.region, i.asset_class,
COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE t.status='MATCHED' ) AS matched_trades,
COUNT(rb.id) FILTER ( WHERE rb.status='OPEN' ) AS open_breaks,
ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(t.quantity*t.price),0)::numeric, 2 ) AS gross_notional,
ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='MATCHED')::numeric *100 /NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2 ) AS match_rate_pct
FROM trades t JOIN counterparties c ON t.counterparty_id=c.id
JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id=i.id
LEFT JOIN recon_breaks rb ON rb.trade_id=t.id
GROUP BY t.trade_date, c.region, i.asset_class
WITH NO DATA;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary ( trade_date, region, asset_class );

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
